sentences.text: Sandalodus belonged to the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fish.
The genus was named by Newberry and Worthen in 1866.
Charles Eastman later classified Sandalodus within the family Cochliodontidae in 1903.
These animals lived from 351.9 to 266.9 million years ago, spanning the Tournaisian to Roadian stages across the Late Devonian, Carboniferous, and Permian periods.
The validity of the genus is debated because some species may belong to the same animal as Deltodus.
